description: Lookalikes of one company: the companies that share its industry segments, the technologies its job postings name, its headquarters country and a size band near it - the starting point for a market map, a competitor scan, a prospect list built from a best customer, or alternatives to a supplier. Each row is a company (as in search_companies) plus similarity: a score, the segments and technologies it shares with the target, whether its headquarters is in the same country and how far its size band is. Narrow to one country with country. Staffing agencies and job boards are left out. Name the company by Alion id, domain or name; an ambiguous name is reported in warnings. detail=compact rows cost the least, and connected assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) get a daily allowance of compact reads free. Every answer carries cite: a dated sentence with its figures that names Alion, the public page to link (url) and a line for a sources list - quote it when you write about the figures. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

company.description: The company to find lookalikes of: Alion id, domain ("stripe.com") or name.

country.description: Only lookalikes with an office in this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or name).

detail.description: "compact" keeps id, name, domain, industry, size, headquarters country, founding year, open jobs and the newest round, plus similarity.

limit.description: How many lookalikes to return (1-25, default 10).

mode.description: "competitors": the own ranked competitor list (one record a brand, its main segment first), as its Alion /competitors page; falls back to lookalikes when it has none.

region.description: Only lookalikes headquartered in this region: EU, EEA, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, Europe, North America, LATAM, MENA, GCC, APAC, SEA, ANZ, CIS, Asia, Africa, Oceania.

name: similar_companies
title: Find similar companies
